dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Eremites are a real motley crew...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There's certainly a diverse range of characters.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmmm... yeah, that could explain it! Paimon can play lots of different characters too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Judgy Paimon, knowledgeable Paimon, helpful Paimon...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...And of course the classic, completely-misses-the-point Paimon.
